text:
tess: Heads-up - vendor onboarding scan surfaced several archives that appear to be encrypted with our old wrap key (projects/redwood-kms/wrappingKeys/onboard-v1). Some archives also include vendor-provided SA JSON. Treat as potential exposure.

ops-bot: Alert: artifact-scan matched pattern 'onboard-v1' in vendor-bundles/partnerX-2026-07-04.tar.gz (hits=4).

miguel: Quick containment: ask vendor to suspend fetches, rotate/delete the SA keys referenced, and add temporary deny binding for that SA. I'll take key deletion.

ari: For Vault/KMS: we should rewrap ciphertexts encrypted under onboard-v1 to a new key version and revoke any tokens that may have been minted by those SAs. I'll own rewrap and token revocation.

tess: Proposed immediate schedule: 18:00 UTC disable vendor access, 18:05 rotate SA keys + apply deny, 18:15 start rewrap (throttle 5/min). Vendor agrees to pause.

infra: Commands to apply deny and list keys:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=vendor-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
for k in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=vendor-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'); do gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete "$k" --iam-account=vendor-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true; done
# add temporary deny
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:vendor-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/owner --condition=None || true
```

miguel: After keys deleted, I'll push a short org-policy deny for any requests signed by that SA to speed containment.

ari: Rewrap checklist: publish signed manifest to secure-analytics, forward unwrap/decrypt audit events to SIEM for 90 days, and require vendor acknowledgement before re-pull.

tess: Also schedule postmortem: tess+ari with infra support. Follow-ups: vendor onboarding checklist update, CI pre-publish archive scanning, and a quarterly rotation drill.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-9910 assigned to eng-security.

miguel: Keys rotated/deleted at 5367891400. Rewrap started 5367891500 (total 12 archives queued). Will update when manifest posted.

ari: Rewrap complete 12/12. Manifest uploaded to s3://secure-analytics/rewrap/INC-2026-9910/manifest.json. Vendor acknowledged and removed old bundles.

tess: Containment closed. Creating follow-up tickets for onboarding policy and CI hooks. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
